exclusions.reason: Only MOVS, STOS, LODS, CMPS and SCAS memory strings are in this finite domain.
Exactly optional67, optional66, repeat, optional48, opcode; other legal prefix orders remain outside this finite scope.
No duplicate, extra or ignored prefix bytes are included.
AMD manual-derived meaning only; no Intel equivalence, especially zero-count address32 upper-lane behavior.
Default flat DS/ES only; FS/GS and other explicit segment prefixes remain open.
INS/OUTS and external port state remain outside the memory-string scope.
Finite normal completion only; hardware exceptions, partial effects, interrupts and restart are not modeled here.

premises: Manual opcode and repeat tables define the selected byte/wide opcode family and F2/F3 condition.
Tables1-2/1-3/1-4 and REX.W fields define operand, address and implicit count/index sizes in AMD long64 mode.
Canonical prefix order is a frozen subset selected before constructing D; flat segments and finite normal completion are explicit premises.
AMD vendor semantics are explicit; hardware zero-count upper-lane differences forbid a cross-vendor inference.
review.limits: Reviewed finite source derivation only. No full-manual legality proof, complete XED-template binding, whole-vendor encoding denominator, fault/restart, IO or segment extension.
